data.name: #from #abandoned
data.detailed_description:
【Game Overview】

#from #abandoned is a survival action horror game where you must escape a ruined hospital stalked by relentless killers. You control five playable characters. But who survives is never predetermined. At the start of every playthrough, five characters are randomly selected from a roster of nine, each with their own unique traits and abilities. Every decision matters. Every survivor's fate is in your hands. Guide all five to freedom.

【Escape with All Five】

Escaping with the first character is only the beginning. Four more lives still remain.

Each survivor starts in different situations.
Each requires different strategies.
Each may encounter different killers.

If even one of them fails to escape, you cannot achieve the true ending. Can you save every one of them?

【Survive the Killers】

Deadly killers roam the abandoned hospital. Each has unique behaviors, hunting patterns, and ways of tracking you.

Will you hide?
Will you run?

Or will you use the environment to outsmart them? Every second counts. One wrong decision could mean death.

【Features】

■ Five Randomly Chosen Survivors
Five characters are randomly selected from a cast of nine. Every playthrough offers different survivor combinations. Your mission isn't over until every selected survivor escapes.

■ Single-Player Survival Horror
Face the nightmare completely alone. No teammates. No rescue. Your own decisions determine who lives and who dies. Learn from failure and discover new escape strategies.

■ Unique Killers
Multiple killers with distinct AI and behaviors. The same location can become a completely different challenge depending on the survivor. Unpredictable pursuits keep every encounter tense.

■ Escape the Abandoned Hospital
Explore the environment. Solve environmental puzzles. Make clever use of items. Find a way to survive with limited resources.

【Recommended For Players Who...】

Enjoy tense survival horror with strategic gameplay.
Love discovering their own escape routes.
Want high replayability through randomized gameplay.
Seek the challenge of saving every survivor.

The fate of five lives rests in your hands. Saving one isn't enough. Only after every survivor escapes can you finally strike back against the mysterious Game Master. Will you lead all five to freedom... or leave them behind?

data.short_description: Take control of five participants selected from a cast of nine and get them all out of an abandoned hospital stalked by killers. With no health bars or HUD to rely on, trust your eyes, ears, and instincts to survive in a survival horror experience built for realism. Can you get all five out alive?
